training.detach_policy: independent 125-token random stream sample resets Session each optimizer update; no detach at internal 32-token write boundaries
training.resume_policy: no optimizer checkpoint recovery; failed model restarts fresh; final weights saved once

data.manifest_hash_convention: epclm001.common.sha canonical JSON; identical to historical run

state.initialization: learnable slot embeddings, independent CPU RNG fork
state.partial_chunk: finish independent sample: flush final 29 after predictions
state.state_projection: one shared 128->188 bridge; Stage Q/K/V and out weights reused
state.B1_read_heads: existing 4 Token Attention heads, no added multihead module; explicitly confirmed by user
state.state_scores: unrotated content Q/K; Token Q/K keep original RoPE
state.gate: one shared sigmoid scalar: memory value gain and FFN residual context

publication.checkpoints: publish final per-arm checkpoints in result branch as explicitly requested by SPEC step 8; no optimizer resume state
publication.decision: finalize before SHA manifest; never mutate after publication
publication.receipt: append independent receipt; verify artifact and receipt commits separately

scope: 1M single-seed within independent 125-token samples; no beyond-128 memory claim
